entities.summary: Richard Ravalomanana is a Malagasy politician and former military officer who served as president of the Senate of Madagascar from 2023 to 2025. He also briefly served as acting president of Madagascar in 2023 during the re-election of President Andry Rajoelina. Some media outlets have said that he is a collaborator of Rajoelina. Richard Ravalomanana was a military leaders & commanders (b. 1959-12-14). Relevant to geopolitics.
